title.zh: 授予Roberto S. Iñigo在卡坦端内斯Calalbon电灯、热力与动力系统特许经营权的法案
title.en: An Act Granting Roberto S. Iñigo a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat and Power System in Calalbon, Catanduanes
title.orig: An Act Granting Roberto S. Iñigo a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat and Power System in Calalbon, Catanduanes
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp quyền khai thác cho Roberto S. Iñigo để xây dựng, lắp đặt, vận hành và duy trì hệ thống điện tại Philippines
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติให้สัมปทานแก่ Roberto S. Iñigo เพื่อก่อสร้าง ติดตั้ง ดำเนินการ และบำรุงรักษาระบบไฟฟ้าในฟิลิปปินส์
title.id: Undang-Undang memberikan waralaba kepada Roberto S. Iñigo untuk membangun, memasang, mengoperasikan, dan memelihara sistem tenaga listrik di Filipina
title.ms: Akta memberikan francais kepada Roberto S. Iñigo untuk membina, memasang, mengendalikan dan menyelenggara sistem tenaga elektrik di Filipina

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1949/ra_398_1949.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Subject to the terms and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and thirty-six as amended by Commonwealth Act Numbered One hundred and thirty-two, and to the provisions of the Constitution, there is granted to Roberto S. Iñigo, for a period of twenty-five years from the approval of this Act, the right, privilege, and authority to construct, maintain, and operate an electric light, heat and/or power system for the purpose of generating and distributing electric light, heat and/or power for sale within the limits of the municipality of Calalbon, Province of Catanduanes.

It is expressly provided that in the event the Government should desire to maintain and operate for itself the plant and enterprise herein authorized, the grantee shall surrender its franchise and will turn over to the Government all serviceable equipment therein, at cost.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1949.
